Learn how to edit videos with Claude AI, work with Premiere Pro, and turn your footage into short-form content.

In this guide, I walk through how to use Claude to help with video editing, from working with your existing footage to creating clips for Shorts and Reels. We’ll explore how Claude fits into an Adobe Premiere Pro workflow and where AI can help with the editing process.

The focus is on making useful content from your own videos, with creative control over the results. Less repetitive work, without filling your feed with AI slop.
